Dark Chocolate Cranberry Bark
By: Carrie Barr
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:59pm

Ingredients




12 ounces dark chocolate
1 cup dried cranberries
1 teaspoon orange zest
1/2 cup chopped nuts (optional)

Preparation

1 Cover cookie sheet (13x9) with wax paper and spray lightly with cooking spray 2 Melt 12 ounces of dark chocolate either in double boiler or in microwave; stir until smooth. Let sit for 5 minutes. 3 Add 1 cup of dried cranberries (any flavor you like), 1 tsp orange zest; and the chopped nuts if you want them. Spread on cookie sheet (it may not cover the whole sheet). 4 Refrigerate until firm. Cut or break apart.
